text:
maria-sales: Hey team — new POC with ZenithCloud. They need our SOC 2 report + NDA signed before we can give S3 test data access. Can we expedite a bridge ack? 
jamal-se: What exactly do they need from the SOC2 — full report or an interim attestation? Who's the contact? 
maria-sales: They asked for "SOC 2 Type II" report, but said temporary access with a bridge letter is ok for now. Contact is @zenith-rep (cornerstone@zenithcloud.com). They want anonymized data for a 2-week POC starting Mon. 
sophia-legal: @maria-sales ok I can do a short bridge ack. Need customer name, scope, and max duration. Also confirm whether they'll accept hashed/sample data only. 
alex-ops: If legal approves, we can provide presigned S3 URLs scoped to a single prefix and expire in 14 days. We'll log accesses. Example presign command we use:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-poc/zenith/ --expires-in 1209600
```
jamal-se: Thanks. Also quick ask on Dedicated pricing for a 2-week reserved pool for the POC — do we have a pre-approved POC discount? 
maria-sales: Sales asked for 30% off committed for 2 weeks; if that complicates legal, we can do a fixed promo credit instead. 
sophia-legal: On NDA — we need a signed mutual NDA before sending presigned links. I can prepare a one-paragraph bridge letter that references the executed NDA and grants temporary data access for testing. I'll add standard redaction and no-retention clauses. 
legal-bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.example/xyz123 — assigned to Zenith contact. 
alex-ops: Once we have signed NDA + bridge ack, I'll provision the bucket, restrict IPs if they request, and turn on server-side encryption. 
jamal-se: Anything blocking on credentials for the POC? Also will embedding tokens be rotated per-session? 
alex-ops: We'll create a scoped API key with token rotation every 24h for the POC. Access logs will be forwarded to S3 + Splunk. 
maria-sales: Timeline check — can legal turn bridge letter + NDA within 24 hours? Customer is pushing to start Monday. 
sophia-legal: I'll draft the bridge ack now and send for internal review. If no red flags, aiming to send to customer within 6-8 hours. 
maria-sales: Amazing, thanks — please cc me when sent. :thumbsup: 
jamal-se: I'll prep minimal dataset and a short notebook so they can start as soon as links land. 
alex-ops: FYI I'll need a traffic estimate to set rate limits — ping me with expected QPS. 
maria-sales: Zenith expects ~50 req/s peak, but low hours otherwise. I'll confirm. 
sophia-legal: Sending draft to internal channel for quick review. @maria-sales @jamal-se expect a final link later today. 
maria-sales: Great — keeping customer in loop. Thanks everyone.
